verdict.rationale: Intuit's developer platform gives some programmatic, non-UI access: a sandbox company comes with every developer profile, and API requests can add, modify or query workers' comp codes. That offers a thin basis for scripted or CI use, but nothing shows payroll itself can be run headlessly. The in-product 'auto payroll' scheduling is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented API or CLI to run payroll programmatically, CI and headless usage guidance, an OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
